summary: This study tested a teamwork approach between doctors and nurses using a smart warning system for hospitalized adults with type 2 diabetes who use insulin pumps. The goal was to see if this method could help prevent dangerously low blood sugar levels and help patients reach stable blood sugar targets. A total of 1255 participants took part in the research. The study compared this new care method against usual care.
